messages:
Tara: quick brainstorm  we need a micro-benchmark postcard + webinar hook that focuses on "median-first" storytelling: median latency matters for UX, but show cost and tail too. keep it snackable.

Jin: love the angle. hero options: 'Median matters. Money follows.' or 'Median latency you can bank on.' shorter is better.

Omar: charts: 1) compact scatter: median latency (ms) on x vs cost per 1k tokens (USD) on y for hosted vs dedicated 2) small stacked bar showing percent token spend saved by batching+cache across prompt mixes 3) compact p95/p99 bars to show tail risk. each chart gets a 1-line plain-English takeaway.

Felix: visual flavor: use a muted palette, subtle callouts, mobile-first stack. include micro-annotation on chart 1: "Typical app mix: 60% short chat, 30% retrieval, 10% long completion" so readers get context.

Zoe: segmentation + routing: two-button flow in email. Button A -> sandbox (fast path) Button B -> book a perf review (enterprise path). detect corporate domains and nudge enterprise button. capture company size (3 buckets) on the demo form.

Tara: subject line A/B test: A) 'Median latency you can count on' B) 'Reduce surprise inference bills' test 5k recipients first wave.

Jin: claims: conservative language only. suggested sentence: "In our mixed-workload tests, batching + prefix caching reduced token spend 2-4x while keeping median latency stable." link to full benchmark for details and CSV.

Omar: eng ask: provide CSV with hosted vs dedicated runs, quantized 4-bit profile, and a small sample prompt mix breakdown. need by Wed noon. also produce one small GIF that animates batching (2-4s).

Felix: design ask: three PNGs + one GIF, ensure captions readable at 320px width. also include an optional alt text for accessibility.

Zoe: routing detail: utm_campaign=median_bench_v1, utm_variant=A/B. landing page uses hidden field campaign_bucket. map sandbox conversions to HS_FORM_SANDBOX, enterprise leads to HS_FORM_PERF. SDRs get flagged when company size >250 or corporate domain + demo booked.

Tara: webinar hook: 30 min total (15 demo, 10 product + eng quick dive, 5 Q&A). Invite developers & platform leads. CTA on webinar LP: "See numbers, run your prompt".

Jin: include a tiny dev fold for quick testing (one-liner curl). keep it safe and generic: ```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-lite","prompt":"Hello","max_tokens":50}'
```

Omar: metrics to track: open rate, click->sandbox conversion, click->demo-book, webinar reg->attend, enterprise MQLs, CAC. set goal: 20% click->sandbox for personal domains, 8% demo-book for corporate domains.

Felix: timeline: draft copy by Mon, charts/GIF by Wed EOD, LP/forms Thurs, QA Fri, test send Mon, live Tue week after. tag @eng-ml for CSV.

Zoe: legal/CS note: any customer quote must be pre-cleared. if not available, use anonymized metrics with source link.

marketing-bot: Campaign scaffolded (id: camp_9107). Drive folder: https://drive.redwood/median-bench-9107. Test send scheduled 2024-11-12T16:00:00Z.

Tara: thanks everyone. I'll draft the short 3-panel copy and upload. please review the Drive doc when I drop it. :sparkles:
